[RDSC.6a.2.5] `ServiceDef.hydration` carries the `hydration:` block
of [LHYD.9.4.1]. `ServiceHydration.max_window_ns` and
`max_limit` use 0 to mean unspecified. Per-field operator
caps are listed verbatim from the source — one of the
seven canonical operators (`==`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`,
`>=`, `in`).
